subject: Oceanography
title: Reef Biodiversity
description: A micro-lesson that makes Reef Biodiversity usable.

hook.text: Coral reefs cover less than 0.1% of the ocean floor—but support 25% of all marine species.

buildup.text: Reefs provide food, shelter, and breeding grounds for thousands of species—from fish to sponges.

discovery.text: The complex three-dimensional structure creates countless niches—every crack and crevice hosts something.

twist.text: Many reef species are still undiscovered—scientists estimate millions may remain unknown.

climax.text: Reef biodiversity also provides medicines—compounds from sponges and corals fight cancer and infections.

punchline.text: The ocean's richest neighborhood sits in its smallest space.

quiz.question: What percentage of marine species do coral reefs support?
